text_block_list.text:
"As cherry blossom petals dance through the sky,
and the green of young buds begins to peek out—"

The day of the Satsuki Sho.
When I headed to the venue with Sakura Laurel,
the stands were packed with spectators.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The excitement is insane...!
Even though the race hasn't even started yet...
choice_data_list: So this is the Classic Triple Crown road...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I managed to slide in too.
Right here...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Biwa Hayahide's sister
is running this year, right!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right, exactly!
BNW's race last year was amazing,
so everyone's got high hopes for her sister too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! I see, so that's another kind of expectation
people have for Brian-chan.
choice_data_list: Because people especially believe what they see with their own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see.
You saw Hayahide-chan, believed in her strength,
and also placed your faith in her sister, Brian-chan.
choice_data_list: Let's see for ourselves how strong that 'running we admire' really is.
Let's also see for ourselves the strength of that "admired running style."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! I'll watch closely with my own two eyes!
I'll see it through to the end!"
It's almost time for the Satsuki Sho paddock.
Her condition just happened to be good this time, allowing Sakura Laurel to enter the Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: (But there's no denying the ticking time bomb in my legs.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...If I feel it's dangerous to push myself any further while running, I will prioritize safety, even if it means slowing down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, right up until the very end, as much as I can...
No, I'm going to run with everything I've got!
choice_data_list: Leave the post-race care to me.

text_block_list.text:
Once the decision to enter this race was made,
I had already made arrangements with the hospital just in case.

And so, I sent Sakura Laurel off
to the paddock for the Satsuki Sho—
